tweets.text:
This script bets on football and has already made $80,000

How does it work

An ML model + Bet365 odds + Polymarket is all we need

The bot itself was built in about 2 days

After 20 hours of running it made +$5,041

Check it: https://t.co/UPSyph2hTm

Here is the full strategy of the script

Five seasons of the English Premier League, La Liga, and Bundesliga. More than 7,600 matches. For each one there are goals, shots, possession, corners, cards, and odds

ELO rating using the FIFA formula. It accounts for opponent strength, goal difference, and home advantage. Not just win draw loss, but the full context of each match

Proxy xG from basic stats. Shots on target times 30 percent conversion plus off target shots times 3 percent. Teams that overperform their expected goals will likely regress to the mean

Rolling averages over 5 matches, fatigue factor, head to head history, day of the week

Claude API analyzes context the model cannot see such as motivation, pressure, and derby matches

Ensemble of models XGBoost, Random Forest, and Logistic Regression. Walk forward backtesting instead of random splits

The bookmaker gives 55 percent probability for a home win. Polymarket gives 48 percent. The model gives 52 percent. KL divergence between sources is the signal. The bigger the disagreement, the stronger the edge

If all three agree, I skip because there is no edge. If two are against one, I bet with the majority side

Kelly criterion determines bet size, Claude explains why
